people.name: Apollos
people.line: Eloquent Jewish Christian from Alexandria, co-worker with Paul

people.name: Paul
people.line: Apostle to the Gentiles, author of many NT epistles

translations.web: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed, and each as the Lord gave to him?
translations.bsb: What then is Apollos? And what is Paul? They are servants through whom you believed, as the Lord has assigned to each his role.
translations.kjv: Who then is Paul, and who is Apollos, but ministers by whom ye believed, even as the Lord gave to every man?
translations.asv: What then is Apollos? and what is Paul? Ministers through whom ye believed; and each as the Lord gave to him.
